title: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 1: Usafi wa sehemu za umma)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds the answer in the passage and checks it fits the question word (nini, nani, wapi, lini, kwa nini).

floor.prerequisite: Reads a short passage and answers who and what.
floor.question: Kifungu kinamhusu nani?
floor.answer: the topic or the main person

steps: Read the question and its question word.
Find the paragraph with the answer.
Answer and check it fits the question.

board.say: Swali hili linataka jibu la aina gani?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child answers and shows where in the text or notes the answer came from.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni jibu lipi linalopatana na matini?" Kwa nini "jibu lisilopatana na matini" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu lazima lijibu swali lote, si jambo moja dogo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni jibu lipi linalopatana na matini?" Kwa nini "jibu lisilopatana na matini" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu lazima lipatane na matini, si kinyume chake.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni jibu lipi linalopatana na matini?" Kwa nini "jibu lisilopatana na matini" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu lazima lipatikane kwenye matini, si kuongezwa kutoka nje.
Swali la "kwa nini" hujibiwa kwa sababu.

checks.question: Kwa nini mhusika alikimbia nyumbani?
checks.answer: kwa sababu aliogopa mbwa wa jirani
